concerns.text: T011 implements FR-012 (Memory Management) but describes the trigger as 'a substantial data volume' instead of the spec's hard constraint '6.5 GB'. This is a semantic weakening of FR-012. The task must explicitly mandate the 6.5 GB threshold to satisfy the requirement.

T034-extended implements optical flow calculation but lacks the specific constraint to implement frame downsampling required to meet the 6-hour runtime limit (Non-Functional Requirement). Without this explicit instruction, the task risks failing the performance constraint, constituting a silent relaxation of the spec.

T031 and T032 implement ANOVA/Bonferroni (FR-005) but do not explicitly mandate verification that the input data is stratified by 'GarmentFeatureClass' (Color, Pattern, Texture) as required by Constitution Principle VI and FR-005. Running ANOVA on unstratified data would violate the core research methodology.

FR-007 and Constitution Principle VII require empirical validation of the 50ms threshold. T025 only flags 'bottlenecks' and T028-logic returns a generic 'DEFERRED' status. Neither task explicitly mandates generating the 'detailed breakdown of latency per component' required to verify the constraint, effectively weakening the verification step.

FR-006 requires a 'sweep' of the optical flow threshold across a range of values. T035 calculates a metric against a 'fixed reference threshold of 0.05'. This is a direct contradiction and weakening of the requirement to perform a sensitivity sweep, rendering the task unable to satisfy FR-006.

Tasks T043-T050 (Phase Revision) contain critical fixes for FR-012 (6.5GB trigger), FR-007 (latency breakdown), and FR-006 (sweep logic) that are missing from the main Phase 2-5 tasks. These tasks are listed in a separate section with no dependency linkage to the main execution flow, creating a risk that the primary implementation tasks (T011, T025, T035) will be executed without the necessary constraints, violating the spec.
